content.title: Request a program
content.summary: Groups such as schools, scouts, and organizations can request nature programs at the Majestic View Nature Center or at their location, with bookings available on a first-come, first-served basis and requiring at least two weeks' notice. In-person programs at the center cost $5 per student with a minimum fee, while outreach programs range from $75 to $95 depending on location. Additionally, Arvada schools can participate in a free Water Wise Classroom Challenge program focused on water conservation, which includes incentives for students who complete related tasks.
content.body:
Whether at the Nature Center, at your school or organization, with your learning pod, or online, any group can request a program. This includes scouts, birthday parties, homeschooling families, teachers, adult groups, day cares, or any party excited about connecting with nature. Programs are booked based on first-come first-serve. Please consider submitting your program request as early as possible, but we do require at least 2 weeks prior to your desired date in order to schedule staff and volunteers.

[Request a Program](https://arvada-forms-mvnc.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/49496 "Request a Program form opens in a new tab or window")

After you request a program, we will respond within 1-2 business day with your confirmation. If you have any trouble with the form  or have further questions, please contact us.

## What you can book

### In-Person programs at Majestic View (field trips)

- In person (at Majestic View) is $5/student with $40 minimum
- Field trip programs are organized by smaller rotations, each rotation is 25-40 minutes. Maximum of 75 students per field trip.
  - If you have more than 25 students, be aware we can only accommodate up to three consecutive in-person programs (75 total students) in one day, which would be a 1.5-2 hour field trip at Majestic View.
- See our [School and Group Programs](/1194) page to view program descriptions and grant-eligible schools

### In-Person outreach programs to you

- In-person Outreaches are 30-60 minutes, $75 (in Arvada) or $95 (outside of Arvada)-discounts for multiple programs in a row
- Outreach programs can be in a classroom or in a park space near you. Outdoor access is preferred for many programs. We will arrive 20-40 minutes prior to program start to set-up materials.

## Available topics

[Pre-programmed topics](/1194) are grade-level appropriate and meet Colorado science standards. Custom topics are available by request, including our Water Wise Classroom Challenge (available free to Arvada schools).

### Water Wise classroom challenge-FREE program

Majestic View Nature Center invites Arvada 3-5th grade class to take part in a special water conservation and water cycle program, free for Arvada area schools. Submit a program request or contact us if you have any questions/special requests.

- This program is offered as an outreach presentation given outside at your school or virtually on Zoom.
- FREE: This program is fully funded by the City of Arvada Utilities Department for Arvada Schools.
- The presentation is 40-60 minutes and covers the water cycle, water quality & conservation, and water in ecosystems-along with other related topics. Each student also receives a water conservation swag bag.
- We can accommodate up to 50 students per in-person program (if outdoors), or up to 75 virtually.  Multiple presentations may be scheduled in one day.
- Students will be requested to participate in at home conservation tasks (timing showers, checking for leaks and other activities).  This take home packet is to be completed within one week and may be used for grades if you wish.
- Upon class completion of their packets, and teacher discretion free pizza will be offered for the participating classroom/grade.
- This program is sponsored by the Nature Center and the City of Arvada Utilities Division.

## Grant funding eligible schools

With our partnership with Jeffco Open Space Foundation (JOSF), we are able to offer programs free of charge to Jeffco Schools low-income schools. With these grant rebates, program fees and/or busing is paid for at no cost to your school. If you are listed as an eligible school below, please let us know when requesting a program. If you are a Title 1 school outside of Jeffco, please let us know for discounted pricing.
